lyrics:
Uh, yeah
Listen, listen
When I got your number, couldn't wait to call that shit (Nah)
Let you call the shots, as long as you don't call it quits (Yeah)
Got a nigga warm, I been on my summer shit
Cupid shot me when I saw you, he was on his hunter shit (Brrah)
From there, feelings got stronger, my temper got shorter, but my love will last longer (Yeah)
Your feelings got distant, my heart was straight tickin' like a bomb and it had your fuckin' name stitched in it (Stitched in it)
Now, this shit ended with a fucked-up distance and we scared to make it somewhat of a fucked-up friendship
I know (Damn), but baby, just hush up, listen
Is that your love I see, or is it fucked-up visions? Who knows? (Right)
But that's what I'ma Stevie Wonder about (Yeah)
It drives me crazy how your feelings fuckin' wandered out (Damn)
It got me thinkin', gave me hella shit to ponder 'bout
You locked in my heart, it ain't no bondin' out and I'm just bein' honest now
And that's just how I'm feelin' (Yeah)
You my superhero, but you fuckin' with a villain
You know (You know), It's you I'm fuckin' missin'
Yo' feelings float away when I'ma scrape 'em off the ceiling for you (For you)
And baby, I admit it, I wanna run this race with you, don't worry 'bout the finish at all (At all)
And now I'm in my feelings, I'm writing hella songs for you and I can't even finish 'em all (Yeah)
Touch the subjects that are sensitive
Got me trippin' over words and stomping over sentences
Got me throwin' tantrums like a motherfuckin' lil' kid
Got me goin' crazy every time I fuckin' reminisce (Got me goin' crazy every time I fuckin' reminisce)
And that's only on a good day (Yeah)
It feel like ya' heart icy like some new J's (Yeah)
My love packin' like a motherfuckin' suitcase, your name in my mouth like some motherfuckin' toothpaste (Damn)
The first kiss to the first date, never grated, never sweated, loved it in the first place
Girl, yo' beauty blow me like the candles on a birthday, got me nervous, got me shakin' like a fuckin' earthquake (Damn)
Look, so I'm just tryna see what you on, we had the old relationships, so we should build a new one
The definition of a woman, baby, you a true one, I refuse to drop that shit and move on
That's why I wrote yo' ass in this new song
And that's just how I'm feelin'
You my superhero, so you fuckin' with a villain
You know, It's you I'm fuckin' missin'
Yo' feelings float away when I'ma scrape 'em off the ceiling for you
And baby, I admit it, I wanna run this race with you, don't worry 'bout the finish at all
And now I'm in my feelings, I'm writing hella songs for you and I can't even finish 'em all
Yeah, I know we goin' through it
But I hope I just put an end to it, yeah
title: You Freestyle
